## Title
**The Bill Cut Kit: find and cut every subscription in an hour (checklist + call scripts + tracker)**

## Short description
Find every recurring charge in 10 minutes, cut what you don't use, and lower the bills you keep with word-for-word scripts. $5.

## Full description
> Subscriptions don't feel expensive at $9.99 a month. They feel expensive at $120 a year, times six, for things you forgot you had.
>
> **The Bill Cut Kit** is a one-evening audit. You check the five places recurring charges hide (including the app-store ones that never show up on your bank statement), decide keep, cut, downgrade or negotiate for each, and use word-for-word scripts to ask for lower prices on the bills you keep.
>
> **What's inside**
> - **Guide (PDF, 9 pages):** where to look, the four-decision rule, how to cancel so it stays cancelled, free-trial habit, call scripts for internet, phone, car/renters insurance, credit card APR, late and annual fees, bank fees and gyms, plus a printable worksheet.
> - **Tracker (.xlsx):** list every charge with how often it bills; it converts everything to a yearly cost, adds up what each decision saves, logs every negotiation call (and reminds you two weeks before a promo price ends), and totals your yearly savings.
>
> **Who it's for:** anyone who's ever said "where does my money go?", and anyone who's never called their internet provider to ask for a better price.
>
> Instant download. Educational content only, not financial advice. Discounts from calls aren't guaranteed; the scripts make asking easy.

## Benefit bullets
- Finds the subscriptions billed through Apple, Google, PayPal and Amazon that hide from your bank statement.
- One decision per charge: keep, cut, downgrade or negotiate.
- Seven word-for-word call scripts, including what to say when they say no.
- See your savings per year, month and week.
- Takes about an hour. Repeat every six months.

## FAQ
**Format?** PDF + .xlsx (Excel, Google Sheets, Numbers). Instant download.
**Does it connect to my bank?** No. You look through your statements yourself; nothing to link.
**Will the scripts definitely get me a discount?** No one can promise that. Companies and offers vary. The kit makes asking quick and painless.
**Outside the US?** The method works anywhere; a few details (like app-store menus) may differ.
